# The Global Meridian (দ্য গ্লোবাল মেরিডিয়ান)

## Coverage Desks
- [World](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/?cat=World): Geopolitics, diplomacy, Europe, Middle East, Asia-Pacific
- [Politics](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/?cat=Politics): Multilateral summits, elections, South Asian governance
- [Business](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/?cat=Business): Central banks, global trade, OECD macroeconomics
- [Technology](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/?cat=Technology): Physical AI, 6G spectrum, semiconductors, robotics
- [Science](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/?cat=Science): Climate science, mRNA breakthroughs, energy extraction
- [Defense](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/?cat=Defense): Maritime corridors, orbital verification, strategic deterrence
- [Environment](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/?cat=Environment): COP31, WMO climate reports, clean transition finance
- [Opinion](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/?cat=Opinion): Geoeconomic and policy analysis
